mechanism: Only replace nearest scan station with first station of shortest open path over all remaining stations; compare its entry distance against every known localization entry as before. Recompute at each scheduling decision. No endpoint or hidden source prior.
development: Same 52 configurations, two rounding models, no numeric parameter tuning.
gate: Both development models complete/audited; mean strictly lower and p95<=REF. If either fails, reject without generating fresh layouts. If passed, freeze code/configs, then same gates on each fresh ordinary and outer model. Retain every regression.
